description: List a Jandy AquaLink RS panel’s variable-speed pump speeds — the named speeds (e.g. Pool, Spa, Cleaner) with each one’s RPM and which one the pump runs at — read through iAqualink WebTouch from the panel’s "VSP Adjust / Set Speed" screen. Use iaqualink_set_pump_speed to switch speeds and iaqualink_set_pump_speed_rpm to change a speed’s RPM.
name: iaqualink_list_pump_speeds
